results.content:
European stocks gained in a choppy trading session as a pullback in oil prices eased some of the inflation and bond-market pressures that have weighed on the region in recent days.

The Stoxx Europe 600 rose 0.3% in London at the close. Brent crude traded around $89 a barrel, down from Friday’s high of $95, after fresh US pressure on Iran stopped short of significant new measures.
results.title: European Stocks Rise as Pullback in Oil Lifts Investor Sentiment - Bloomberg

results.content:
NVIDIA broke its seven day losing streak, closing up 2.2 percent, while Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) rose after Raymond James upgraded the stock. Falling oil prices and bond yields also improved investor sentiment.

Wednesday’s (August 26) PCE reading came in hotter than expected, sending indexes lower. Tech was mixed, with NVIDIA falling in regular trading and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) leading gains among mega caps.
